purpose: Assess whether original training instructions provide geometrically grounded instruction-dependent endpoint label reversals under the same observed history. No fitting or model inference.

history.observation_rule: first_visit_nodes_only; repeated visited nodes are transit, not new observations
history.execution_boundary: CPU verifies reference edge connectivity and a discovered-map path with visited-only intermediate nodes. A simulator replay must later verify actual DUET shortest-route, candidate-view angles, and observation parity.

sampling.enumeration: all unordered same-start original-path pairs, before any model scores
sampling.primary_manifest: all selected path-disjoint exact-heading eligible pairs

coverage_gate.interpretation: Engineering pilot feasibility gate, not a power calculation or evidence of method benefit. Failure stops this strict same-start candidate; do not relax heading or goal rules after inspecting counts.

access_policy.scope: original training annotations and connectivity only

semantic_limits: Distance-based goal membership is not proof of complete instruction following.
Shared start alone does not ensure compatible initial orientation; non-exact headings remain descriptive strata.
The shared overshoot history need not obey both original instructions; it supports endpoint recognition only, not action imitation labels.
train_dev scenes were seen by the official frozen base-model training recipe.
